Subject: Alignment plan: milestones & owners (draft)

Hi Alex — great conversation this morning. Below is a concise recap and an initial draft of the action plan (attached) so we can align on owners, milestones, and a tentative close window. Please review and flag anything I missed.

Summary of call
- Goal: Pilot Redwood inference (dedicated) for clinical documentation generation across 3 clinics.
- Success criteria: <10% post-edit rate on discharge summaries, <300ms median token latency, and cost target <$0.001/token operational.
- Key constraints: SOC 2 evidence required, data residency in us-west, procurement window tied to fiscal Q2 budget.

Proposed MAP (attached: ZENITH_MAP_v1.xlsx) — high level
1) Pilot kickoff (owner: Zenith IT / Alex) — Target: 2027-04-05 — Dependencies: test data export, account provisioning
2) Integration & seeding (owner: Zenith DevOps / Procurement) — Target: 2027-04-19 — Dependencies: VPC peering, KMS key exchange
3) Evaluation & quality tuning (owner: Zenith Clinical Ops / Marcus as Redwood lead) — Target: 2027-05-10 — Dependencies: evaluation prompts, baseline metrics
4) Production rollout decision (owner: Zenith leadership) — Target: 2027-05-24 — Dependencies: budget sign-off, SOC2 check complete

Action items for Alex
- Confirm pilot stakeholders and their backups by 2027-03-08
- Share sample data export template by 2027-03-10 (redwood can provide sample script)

Ben

Redwood Inference

I'll review the XLS and send annotated comments. Appreciate the clear deadlines.
